section_role: introduction and related work and method start

method_evidence.claim: We introduce MaterialMVP, a one-stage model designed to generate PBR textures for 3D meshes.
method_evidence.anchor: We introduce MaterialMVP, a one-stage model designed to generate PBR textures for 3D meshes.

method_evidence.claim: We employ a Multiview Diffusion Model framework designed to generate multiple view-consistent PBR maps from image prompts.
method_evidence.anchor: we employ a Multiview Diffusion Model framework designed to generate multiple view-consistent PBR maps from image prompts.

method_evidence.claim: We introduce a Dual-Channel Material Generation framework, which extends the original diffusion model by adding an extra channel to generate metallic-roughness (MR) alongside the existing albedo channel.
method_evidence.anchor: we introduce a Dual-Channel Material Generation framework, which extends the original diffusion model by adding an extra channel to generate metallic-roughness (MR) alongside the existing albedo channel.

method_evidence.claim: We introduce Consistency-Regularized Training. This strategy trains the model on pairs of reference images with subtle variations in camera pose and lighting but requires the model to produce identical, lighting-invariant results.
method_evidence.anchor: we introduce Consistency-Regularized Training. This strategy trains the model on pairs of reference images with subtle variations in camera pose and lighting but requires the model to produce identical, lighting-invariant results.

method_evidence.claim: We design a Multi-Channel Aligned Attention module to synchronize information between the albedo and MR channels, ensuring the output materials are well-aligned.
method_evidence.anchor: we design a Multi-Channel Aligned Attention module to synchronize information between the albedo and MR channels, ensuring the output materials are well-aligned

figure_table_roles.caption: Overview of MaterialMVP, which takes a 3D mesh and a reference image as input and generates high-quality PBR textures through multi-view PBR diffusion. The albedo and MR channels are aligned via MCAA, effectively reducing artifacts. And Consistency-Regularized Training effectively eliminates illumination and addresses material inconsistency across multi-view PBR textures.
